# rubrik_gcp_kms_key_manager (Data Source)

The `rubrik_gcp_kms_key_manager` data source is used to look up a single GCP
Cloud KMS key manager registered in RSC, by name or by ID.

A key manager is a stored connection profile giving RSC access to a customer
owned key management service. Its ID is generated by RSC and is the value
archival locations refer to the key manager by, alongside the name and version
of the crypto key itself, which come from GCP.

~> **Note:** Key managers are registered in the RSC UI, under Settings,
   Security, Encryption Management. There is no Terraform resource for
   registering one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a GCP Cloud KMS key manager by the name it was registered with in
# RSC.
data "rubrik_gcp_kms_key_manager" "production" {
  name = "Production GCP Cloud KMS"
}

# A key manager can also be looked up by ID, to read the rest of its details.
data "rubrik_gcp_kms_key_manager" "by_id" {
  id = "8d2d0ee8-6b5a-4a58-b2a1-cd0b5f4ee2a4"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) RSC key manager ID (UUID). This is the value archival locations refer to the key manager by. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be specified.
- `name` (String) Key manager name. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be specified.

### Read-Only

- `cloud_account_id` (String) RSC cloud account ID of the GCP project holding the key ring.
- `data_locations_count` (Number) Number of data locations encrypted with keys from this key manager.
- `description` (String) Key manager description.
- `key_ring` (String) Key ring name.
- `natural_id` (String) Identifies what the key manager connects to, rather than the key manager itself: the key ring name.
- `provisioning_method` (String) How RSC obtains the credentials it reaches Cloud KMS with. Possible value is `CLOUD_ACCOUNT_PROVISION`.
- `region` (String) Cloud KMS location of the key ring.
